Sessions / Session 01

Session 01 — The Boarding of the Saltwright

Player-facing recap: Session 01 Recap

Durable Changes

  • Party boarded and seized the Saltwright, a two-masted merchant brig.
  • Geoffrey Draves (19, Dravosi deckhand/carpenter) defected. Party’s only crew member.
  • Two Dravosi Enforcers and two Dravosi Deckhands dead.
  • Dravosi Alchemist brought down on the gangplank. Bandolier with Grung toxin canisters is somewhere on the Saltwright deck.
  • Beaumont Sel joined the fight; actively engaged.
  • Barnaby Rook is alive, unharmed, alone on the HCS Surety gangplank.

Scene Log

  • Hold ambush: Party waited below while Beaumont kept Rook at the wheel. The Dravosi Enforcer (called Cap’n Gorgeous — tall, golden hair) came down first; dropped by poisoned arrow and musket shot. Perrin’s Minor Illusion concealed the doorway. Crissdalynn dragged Cap’n Gorgeous back through it. Two deckhands came down uncertain and were killed.
  • Deck breach: Delmar knelt as a launch platform; Crissdalynn cleared the hatch and snapped her wings, knocking two Dravosi sprawling. Perrin and Jean-Claude emerged from a second gap. Remaining crew killed or defected. Geoffrey Draves surrendered, then defected when Delmar offered protection.
  • Gangplank standoff: Jean-Claude opened with the Flask of Endless Water geyser — blasted Rook off the plank. Enforcer died. Alchemist deployed Grung toxin canister; Jean-Claude and Perrin resisted. Crissdalynn’s Gust redirected the cloud back. Alchemist brought down. Rook hauled back over, fired at Beaumont — round deflected off Salvaged Antheri Plate. Session ended at standoff.

Entity Updates

  • Beaumont Sel — Salvaged Antheri Plate confirmed functional; in the fight
  • Barnaby Rook — unharmed, alone on HCS Surety gangplank; flintlock fired once
  • Geoffrey Draves — defected; party’s only crew member; ship’s carpenter
  • Jean-Claude Tabarnack — identified Simone’s toxin; said nothing

Situation And Faction Updates

  • Situation created: The Rook Resolution — Rook alive and armed at session break
  • Situation created: The Canister — Jean-Claude holds knowledge of Simone’s Crown supply (DM-only)
  • Dravosi Crown — lost Rook’s boarding crew; using Grung toxin in field operations

Open Questions

  • What does Barnaby Rook do at the start of Session 02?
  • What’s aboard the HCS Surety?
  • Where is the Alchemist’s bandolier? Does the party examine it?
  • Does Jean-Claude tell anyone about Simone?

Follow-Up Queue

  • Expand Geoffrey Draves before next session — skills, disposition, what he wants
  • Decide Rook’s fate (capture, escape, death, deal)
  • Update party-session-primer with crew status and Saltwright ownership
